name: Artisan Jeweler
tagline: An earthy, working storefront for a handmade jeweler.
description: A complete, working shop for a handmade / artisan jeweler: a real catalogue of hand-forged pieces in recycled sterling silver and bronze — hammered hoops, a raw-stone ring, a hand-stamped cuff, a mixed-metal pendant, studs, a forged chain, a signet and a raw birthstone pendant — with Metal and Size variants, categories, collections, a bespoke PDP and a merchandised home page. Earthy theme — warm clay ground, bark ink, oxidised-bronze primary, fired-copper accent. Shipped as Forge & Fold.
